description:
Spring Boot test harness for the UiDiagram editor pipeline. Bundles
        mc-workflow-ui-diagram (the builder), mc-semantic-ui-ext-diagram (the
        renderer node + Web-Component) and mc-semantic-ui-core (the dispatcher),
        exposes a tiny REST API that returns pre-baked sample workflows as
        UiDiagram JSON, and ships a static index.html that wires the renderer
        up in the browser. The point: run `mvn spring-boot:run` here and see
        the diagram in a browser without standing up the rest of the monorepo.
